# Modular industrial starter collection

Six compatible-looking, static modular pieces from the same CC0 ModKit source revision
are approved. This is an **untextured, stylized starter collection**, not a complete
playable map. The assembled outpost and additional kit pieces remain in quarantine
until individually reviewed. Grid alignment, collision, navigability and target-engine
compatibility have not been verified as a set.

- [Doorway wall](../../assets/buildings/modular/industrial/modkit-wall-doorway-4m/)
- [Window-opening wall](../../assets/buildings/modular/industrial/modkit-wall-window-4m/)
- [Straight wall](../../assets/buildings/modular/industrial/modkit-wall-straight-4m/)
- [Floor slab](../../assets/buildings/modular/industrial/modkit-floor-4m/)
- [Floor hatch panel](../../assets/buildings/modular/industrial/modkit-floor-hatch/) — static; no opening animation
- [Railing](../../assets/buildings/modular/industrial/modkit-railing-4m/)

Each folder contains the actual model, license, provenance, review and inspection
renders. See the [per-asset license audit](../licenses.md) for rights and caveats.
